name: Holy Mission
english_description: A large (~24,000 .lpc file), heavily player-authored MudOS-lineage fantasy world originally run out of Linz, Austria (the login banner reads 'Welcome to the Holy Mission at Linz, Austria'). Character creation is a straight race pick across seven Tolkien-flavored races -- human, elf, half-elf, dwarf, hobbit, orc, and troll -- each with its own short lore blurb straight from the archive's own doc/races files (hobbits explicitly called out as natural thieves for their agility, orcs as 'usually an evil race' but not fixed-alignment, trolls as large, slow, inately-evil brutes), feeding into five class guilds each split into three sub-specializations: priest (druid/shaman/monk), adventurer (ranger/vagabond/jedi), mage (fire/water/earth/air elemental), fighter (barbarian/berserker/samurai), and thief (pirate/ninja/assassin). The adventurers' guild runs a real fetch quest ('Retrieve the Orc slayer from the evil orc shaman, and give it to Leo'). The starting village radiates out from a church consecrated to 'Illuvatar' (a direct Tolkien reference) that revives the dead at its own altar, with a churchyard, sewers, a guard house, bank, shops, and the guildhouse nearby, plus a separate orc valley, forest, mines, and a whole distinct 'south' region -- extensive player/wizard-authored content built up over years of individual work (the archive's own comments date from the early-to-mid 1990s onward).
